correctness.rationale: Coarea gives the exact normalized density parametrization; the spline inclusion-exclusion formula is derived by independent uniform convolution. On each sign/signed-sum chamber the density is a polynomial divided by the square-free coordinate product; a hypothetical planar rational image forces its linear form to divide that product, hence be coordinate. Conditional positive density strictly rules out non-dominant coordinate plateaus, and a semialgebraic dimension/irreducible-image argument excludes hidden algebraic hyperplane components on chamber walls. Facet shapes follow from exact conditional probability. Affine covariance is verified by the hyperplane Jacobian. The package checker passed 7,741 deterministic exact/numerical assertions, not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The claim resolves a concrete published all-dimensional geometric tomography conjecture, replacing computations confined to dimensions at most five with a uniform proof. It identifies exact shapes and support hyperplanes of every facet, and extends by affine covariance to all centered parallelotopes. The polynomial-denominator obstruction is structural and applies for arbitrarily many cube coordinates, not a small numerical increment.
